column5: 秘术效果文本
column10: 秘术效果文本备用

column5: textEffect
Unfading Sunset, day sets in the west; Intent grows dim, scattering thoughts; Moves like dragon and serpent roam free, unbound by rigid form.
column10: 无锋残阳，日暮西落，此卷心念黯然散淡，招式似龙蛇气逸，不拘规章。

column5: Fists and palms forged a hundred times, gain fierce strength; True power arrives, shattering stone, breaking steles—effortless as turning a palm.
column10: 拳掌百锻，亦得坚猛，真力到处，裂石开碑易如反掌。

column5: A true hero masters skills against thousands; Why should he demean himself, mourning the fairer sex? Power bursts forth with a thousand pounds of force; Though the blade lacks an edge, it still glides through armor.
column10: 英雄本学万人敌，何须屑屑悲红妆。力贯千钧，纵使重刃无锋，仍能衣甲平过。

column5: Peach Blossom's Fair Face, power like spring waters, soft as first love, shattering a thousand troops.
column10: 桃花人面，势若春水，柔若初情，千军自破。

column5: Authored by Tang Hen, former leader of the Tang Sect; originally a secret not to be shared beyond Tangmen, yet somehow it has flowed into the Jianghu in recent years.
column10: 唐门前代门主唐恨所撰，本是唐门不传之秘，但却不知为何，于近年间流入江湖。

column5: Mariners speak of Yingzhou Island; Misty waves conceal it, hard to reach. A secret scroll passed down from the Eastern Sea (Japan), unknown author; its mysteries obscure and difficult to express.
column10: 海客谈瀛洲，烟涛微茫信难求。此乃东瀛流传而来的秘卷，不知何人所撰，其中奥妙晦涩难言。

column5: The methods of observing mountains and meridians recorded in this secret scroll are abstruse; yet if one follows them diligently, perhaps gains can be made.
column10: 此册秘卷所载望山观脉之法晦涩难言，然若能依法而行，许能有获。

column5: To fulfill soaring ambitions, ascend thousands of feet high; This scroll written by a sage of a past dynasty contains infinite mysteries.
column10: 愿遂凌云志，直上数千尺，此册秘卷乃旧朝高人写就，奥妙无穷。

column5: West wind's long lament, border town as yesterday; Majestic, immovable; When stirred, possesses the force of a thousand pounds.
column10: 西风长肃，边城如昨，岿然莫撼，动则有千钧之力。

column5: Mariners speak of Yingzhou Island; Misty waves conceal it, hard to reach. A secret scroll passed down from the Eastern Sea (Japan), unknown author; its mysteries obscure and difficult to express.
column10: 最伤人者，莫过相思，此乃昔年马踏江湖时自唐门中流出之物。

column5: The energy within this scroll is like a vast cascading waterfall, exhaustively detailing the essence of using softness to overcome hardness.
column10: 海客谈瀛洲，烟涛微茫信难求。此乃东瀛流传而来的秘卷，不知何人所撰，其中奥妙晦涩难言。

column5: The lion uses full strength even against a hare; From the first move, all power is unleashed—this is called the bravery of the Great Way.
column10: 此册秘卷中所载之势如万丈鸿瀑，尽述以柔克刚之精要。

column5: A thousand streams hang over the sea, flying rapids rush onward; This is the force of form—unavoidable, unstoppable.
column10: 雄狮搏兔亦尽全力，自起势之时，劲力皆出，谓大道之勇。

column5: Long Life Knotted Flesh, energy stored within the body; The Daoist method of concealing power, subtly aligning with Heaven's Dao.
column10: 千川挂海，飞瀑奔流，此谓形之势，无可避，无可当。

column5: Advancing without fault, enacting Heaven's punishment, the rectitude of the Qian Trigram.
column10: 长生结发，劲藏寓体，乃道家藏劲之法，暗合天道。

column5: Subdue with presence, overcome with form; Break one finger to strike the vital line.
column10: 震行无眚，代天刑罚，正法之乾。

column5: Mortal dust, ill-fated journey; abandoning the world is hard to survive; Origin of this scroll hard to trace; practitioners are said to meet miserable, sudden deaths—truly ill-omened.
column10: 以势镇，以形伏，破其一指，攻敌一线。

column5: The moon's phases wax and wane, as humans know joy and sorrow; A Hidden Moon Tower secret art that only women can practice.
column10: 红尘逆旅，弃世难存，此卷来历难究，据传习者皆凄惨横死，实为不详。

column5: Created by "Blade Ancestor" Yu Hongmei. She slaughtered all in Great Snow Mountain proclaiming: "Man is chopper, I the meat; today, I shall be the chopper."
column10: 月相晦朔，人亦悲欢，隐月楼秘传之术，非女子无法习练。

column5: The distinction of clear and turbid merges into origin; Without distinguishing clear from turbid, one can contain all rivers and things.
column10: 刀祖”于红梅所创，其人诛尽大雪山言曰：人为刀俎，我为鱼肉，今，吾当为刀俎。

column5: Earth bears all things, allowing growth; Life, soul, heart, body—all are anchored here.
column10: 清浊之辨，融汇成元，无分清浊，方可纳百川万物。

column5: The few become many; sand piles form towers; Ancient fortresses, mountains; with small steps, a peak can be scaled.
column10: 地载万物，可得生长，命魂心体，皆系于此。

column5: Passed down from Zhenguo Wei formations, tactics of concentrated offense; Attack resides within defense, expanding territory—its momentum never fades.
column10: 聚少成多，积沙成塔，故垒之峦，跬步可成岳山。

column5: Abbot Kongyuan once said: "A century of meditation, no desires unmastered, no mind unrefreshed." This scroll holds fragments of his enlightenment.
column10: 传自镇国卫行伍间结阵攻坚之法，寓攻于守，拓土开疆，其势不衰。

column5: Evening Bell of Nanping; brings clarity to both mind and Chan; Cleansing dust and vulgarity; proving the golden bell's sound of mercy and spacious refuge.
column10: 空远方丈曾言，禅修百载，无所诸欲不可御，无所诸心不可新，此卷为其所悟之学片语。

column5: Human life is like a dream, illusory, unreal; Only by securing the root and guarding the mind, maintaining an ever-present vitality, can one roam free and broad.
column10: 晚钟南屏，可得心禅两明，涤尘洗俗，证金钟慈悲广厦音。

column5: Aged twenty-seven, Bi Cheng, leader of Sky-Cloud Water Stronghold, slew leaders of twelve water strongholds, annexed bandits of Hundred Rivers, and ascended as Lord of the Greenwoods. Drunk until dawn, moved by excitement, he wrote this scroll's essence.
column10: 人世若梦，似虚如幻，唯固源守心，得气息在在，逍遥广大。

column5: Earth gives birth to all things, but humans alone receive its spirit; Through obscure chances, we become the lords of creation.
column10: 壁城水寨连天云二十七岁，诛十二水寨，收百川江河水贼而纳，登绿林共主，醉饮达旦，兴之所至，挥笔写就此卷精义。

column3: Earth: Pride of the Earth Scroll
column5: All dharmas are empty in nature; neither born nor destroyed; neither defiled nor pure; neither increasing nor decreasing; like earth bearing all things—unmoving, unchanging.
column10: 地生万物，唯人独得其灵，冥冥际遇，为万物之长。

column5: Hearing tides, viewing seas; stepping on reefs, touching stones; Lamenting hidden reefs; able to withstand the current, eternally unrotted.
column10: 诸法空相，不生不灭，不垢不净，不增不减，如地载万物，不动不变也。

column5: Passed down from the Shenshou Dynasty court, a person named Li from the inner forbidden palace; what it describes and contains is only: repay blood with blood, retribution given.
column10: 听潮观海，踏礁触石，嗟叹暗礁，可中流抵水，万世不腐。

column5: Thick Earth bears all things, the masses gain sustenance; the broad manifestation of Kun; Nine being the ultimate number.
column10: 传自神狩朝堂，大内禁宫李姓之人，所述所载，唯以血抵血，报应相偿。

column5: Hairpin and Sword have righteousness; heroines slay evil; Passed down from Shenxiu Peak; Stated: Only the chivalrous can face the world without shame.
column10: 厚土载物，诸子得食，坤之广象，玖数至极。

column5: The blood, qi, sinews, and bones are also like a blade's edge; If constantly tempered, can shatter mountains, shake peaks, break horses, crush armor.
column10: 钗剑有义，巾帼诛邪，传自神秀峰，曰：唯侠者，可不愧于世。

column5: Lone Phoenix violates the Sun, Red Tassel rends the Sky; Knowledge passed down from the Zhenguo Wei.
column10: 血气筋骨亦如刃锋，如能久经磨砺，则可崩山撼岳，断马摧甲。

column5: Mariners speak of Yingzhou Island; Misty waves conceal it, hard to reach. A secret scroll passed down from the Eastern Sea (Japan), unknown author; its mysteries obscure and difficult to express.
column10: 孤鸾犯日，红缨撕天，昔年镇国卫所传之学。

column5: Magpie's tail like a blade; its form both hard and soft; enduring a hundred damages without breaking.
column10: 海客谈瀛洲，烟涛微茫信难求。此乃东瀛流传而来的秘卷，不知何人所撰，其中奥妙晦涩难言。

column5: Love like soft threads, wringing the heart, snapping the guts. This secret scroll is a secret method of the Miaojiang Five Immortals Sect (Five Poisons Sect), which entered the Wulin after the Campaign Subduing the Martial World.
column10: 鹊尾如刀，其形亦刚亦柔，百损不折。

column5: The great sound is faint; the great form has no shape; A secret scroll emerging from an unknown, empty valley; its source untraceable.
column10: 情如柔丝，绞心断肠。此册秘卷乃苗疆五圣教秘传之法，因马踏江湖流入武林。

column5: To the scholar: be adept at accepting counsel and diligent in practice; The cultural vein flows far; one may reach the pinnacle of mastery.
column10: 大音希声，大象无形，秘卷出自一无名空谷，其源不可考。

column5: Said to be by "Gentleman Liang" who infiltrated Hidden Moon Pavilion three times; Moving like a lone swan treading snow, leaving no trace. Since this man was executed by the Zhenguo Wei, the scroll wandered the Jianghu.
column10: 致于学者，善纳言而敏习，文脉流远，可抵臻化。

column5: This scroll passed down from Tianya Haige; Master Dongbi personally investigated medicinal properties, imitating Shennong tasting hundreds of herbs. Thus, he authored this scroll.
column10: 据传为曾三入隐月阁的“梁君子”所著，行若孤鸿踏雪，爪痕无迹，自此人为镇国卫所诛，此卷便流落江湖。

column5: Passed down from the Southern Border Five Immortals Sect; the Gu recorded on it are damaged and hard to distinguish; but carrying it on one's person can strengthen sinews and bones, greatly aiding martial arts.
column10: 此卷传自天涯海阁，东壁先生曾亲探药性，仿神农氏尝百草著医，终成此卷。

column5: Hanging the gourd to aid the world, the physician's benevolent heart; Written by Master Dongbi of Tianya Haige; unparalleled prescriptions for treating wounds and curing ills.
column10: 传自南疆五圣教，其上所载蛊物缺失难辨，但携于身侧，亦可令筋骨强健，于武学一途大有助益。

column5: Celestial Workmanship, intricate and clever; can give rise to masterful design; This scroll passed down from the Mohist Celestial Craft Pavilion; without the talent of a consummate artisan, one cannot grasp its essence.
column10: 悬壶济世，医者仁心，为天涯海阁东壁先生所著，乃疗伤丹治之无上妙方。

column5: The spirit of Heaven and Earth, occasionally captured by a skillful hand; Though not relying on the cosmos' vast power, a gentleman excels at making use of tools.
column10: 天工精巧，可衍匠心，此卷传自墨家天工阁，非能工巧匠，不可得其精意。

column5: Created by a former Celestial Master of Longhu Mountain; harnessing the Dragon-Tiger Purple Qi; true orthodox methods achieve resplendent momentum.
column10: 天地之灵，偶得妙手，虽不籍天地伟力，而君子善假于物也。

column5: The white-robed monk crossed; a single reed traversed the river; After the destruction of Shaolin, the Two Chan split. This hidden scroll also flowed out then, whereabouts unknown.
column10: 龙虎山前代天师所创，龙虎紫气驭行，真法正宗，成煌煌之势。

column5: Live sharing the quilt; die sharing the grave; longing deep in the bones, love-hate unfinished; Created by Golden Phoenix, former leader of the Five Immortals Sect (Five Poisons Sect).
column10: 白衣僧渡，一苇横江，少林既毁，两禅分立，此卷秘藏亦就此流出，不知所踪。

column5: To fulfill soaring ambitions, ascend thousands of feet high; This scroll written by a sage of a past dynasty contains infinite mysteries.
column10: 生当同衾，死亦同穴，缠绵入骨，情恨未了，五圣教前任教主金凰儿所创。
